text.characters: Software agents should act on meaning, not pixels.
Semwright is a semantic execution layer for reliable computer use: typed capabilities, native APIs, policy, refs, provenance and evidence.
The model decides what. Semwright handles what happened.
High-level intent compiles to native objects, then Semwright measures actual state and checks explicit contracts. Judgment stays agentic; mechanics become deterministic.
Current document semantics and bounded design-system context.
Explicit revision-bound ChangeSet; no authority implied.
Native Figma nodes, TextNodes, Auto Layout and bindings.
Observed geometry comes back from Figma, not from guesses.
Deterministic findings plus visual evidence; bounded repair only.
Give stronger models a stronger execution layer.
Native APIs, typed semantics and evidence are infrastructure, not prompt tricks.
Typed capabilities, native APIs, policy, refs and evidence for reliable agentic computer use.
A stronger execution layer for stronger models.
